prompt: Generate 3 drug candidates for Alzheimer's disease targeting BACE1. Use device cuda:0. Property constraints: LogP between 0 and 3, QED > 0.5, Vina docking score < -7 kcal/mol.

assertions.text: produces_sdf_files: Should produce at least 1 SDF file containing candidate molecules
produces_visualizations: Should produce molecular visualizations (PNG images)
produces_markdown_report: Should produce a markdown report with target introduction, methods, and results
report_contains_uniprot_id: Report should contain UniProt ID for BACE1 (P56817) obtained from web search
report_mentions_pdb_structure: Report should mention PDB structures found through database search
